rule: chosen on development (leave-one-mouse-out / LOMO / dev sessions) and confirmed on selection data before any final data were opened; final data are evaluated once by scripts/phase15/run_final15.py

identity.note: OnlineUnits15 on top of frozen OU-P14 parameters (min_gain 80, merge off, snr_assign 6); assignment threshold max(tau_assign, 1 + tau_rel * mean(mu^2))

B-P15.features: line20 + ms3 spatially whitened K=1/K=2 statistics + temporal features + SNR
B-P15.threshold: per-recording self-calibrated quantile 0.998 of development singles (nested LOMO choice)

localization.A-P15: mean of ms3 and line20 spatially whitened K=1 centres
localization.uncertainty: Mondrian split-conformal discs, bins observed-SNR tertile x declared overlap, calibrated leave-one-morphology-out (reports/phase15/uncertainty15_lomo.json)

vision.primary: D-P15 (single spec) decides the reported result; the routed variant is a pre-registered secondary
